tour.overview:
Akumal, whose name means 'place of the turtles' in Maya, is a bay where green sea turtles graze on seagrass in shallow water, protected by local rules that limit visitors and require guides. Inland, the Yucatán is riddled with cenotes, flooded caves and sinkholes connected by some of the longest underwater cave systems in the world, such as Dos Ojos, with water so clear it seems invisible.

This private day takes you snorkelling in both with a certified guide and a vehicle.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 7 hours
• Start and end: your hotel in Cancún, Playa del Carmen or Tulum
• Type: private tour with certified guide, vehicle and driver
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy; basic swimming ability

WHAT YOU SEE
• Akumal bay.
• The Dos Ojos cenotes.
• A jungle cenote.
• A Caribbean beach.

WHY THIS WORKS
A private guide in the water makes snorkelling with turtles and in caverns easy and respectful of the rules.

WHO IT SUITS
Families, couples and snorkellers.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For Maya ruins, choose our Tulum and Cobá tour.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
Life vests are compulsory at Akumal. Use biodegradable sun cream only, or none. Do not touch the turtles.

days.name: Sea turtles at Akumal, the Dos Ojos cenotes and a jungle cenote
days.description:
What to expect: snorkelling with turtles and in cenotes, with a certified guide, private vehicle, entrances, equipment and lunch.

Your driver and guide collect you at about 8:00 and drive to Akumal. Wearing a life vest, you swim out into the bay with your guide, who finds the green sea turtles grazing on the seagrass and surfacing to breathe; you may also see rays, barracudas and reef fish. Your guide explains the rules that protect the turtles.

You then drive to Dos Ojos, 'two eyes', two cenotes linked by a cavern. With a mask and a torch, you float through crystal-clear water among stalactites and stalagmites, with sunbeams falling from the openings. A second, open cenote in the jungle, ringed by trees, offers a quieter swim. Lunch is at a beach restaurant by the Caribbean before you return to your hotel.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:00 – Pick-up.
09:00 – Snorkelling with turtles at Akumal.
11:00 – Dos Ojos cenotes.
12:30 – Jungle cenote.
13:30 – Beach lunch.
15:00 – Back at your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Certified divers can dive Dos Ojos with a cave-diving centre.
• Bring an underwater camera.

INCLUDED: private vehicle and driver, certified guide, entrances and fees, equipment, beach lunch, bottled water, hotel pick-up and drop-off.
NOT INCLUDED: drinks, tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: lunch.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Will we see turtles?
faq.answer: Very likely at Akumal; they are wild, so sightings are never guaranteed.

faq.question: Do we need to be good swimmers?
faq.answer: Basic swimming ability is enough; life vests are compulsory and provided.

faq.question: Is cavern snorkelling scary?
faq.answer: No; you stay in open caverns with daylight, close to your guide.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
Can we use sun cream?
faq.answer: Only biodegradable, or none, to protect the water.

faq.question: Will we be taken to shops?
faq.answer: No. There are no commission stops.

faq.question: What should we bring?
faq.answer: Swimwear, a towel, a change of clothes and an underwater camera.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: All year; turtles are present year-round.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is customary in Mexico: 10 to 15 percent for guides and drivers is usual if you were happy with the service, but it is always your choice.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
